name: Password Strength Estimator
summary: Offline entropy and crack-time estimate for selected text.

manifest.json.name: Password Strength Estimator
manifest.json.author: local
manifest.json.description: Offline entropy and crack-time estimate for selected text.

config.script:
import base64, math, re
pwd = base64.b64decode("{{selection.text.b64}}").decode("utf-8", "replace")
if not pwd:
    print("PASSWORD ANALYSIS\nNo selected text.")
    raise SystemExit
charset = 0
checks = [
    ("lowercase", bool(re.search(r"[a-z]", pwd)), 26),
    ("uppercase", bool(re.search(r"[A-Z]", pwd)), 26),
    ("digits", bool(re.search(r"\d", pwd)), 10),
    ("symbols", bool(re.search(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", pwd)), 32),
]
for _, ok, size in checks:
    if ok: charset += size
entropy = len(pwd) * math.log2(max(charset, 1))
penalty = 0
notes = []
if re.search(r"^[A-Z][a-z]+[0-9!?.]*$", pwd):
    penalty += 12; notes.append("common capitalized-word pattern")
if re.search(r"(1234|qwerty|password|admin)", pwd.lower()):
    penalty += 20; notes.append("common weak token")
effective = max(0, entropy - penalty)
def crack(seconds):
    if seconds < 60: return f"{seconds:.1f}s"
    if seconds < 3600: return f"{seconds/60:.1f}m"
    if seconds < 86400: return f"{seconds/3600:.1f}h"
    if seconds < 31536000: return f"{seconds/86400:.1f}d"
    return f"{seconds/31536000:.1f}y"
guesses = 2 ** min(effective, 120)
score = max(0, min(100, int(effective * 1.15)))
print("PASSWORD ANALYSIS")
print(f"Length: {len(pwd)} chars")
print(f"Charset: {charset}")
print(f"Entropy: {entropy:.1f} bit | effective: {effective:.1f} bit")
print(f"Online throttled: {crack(guesses / 100)}")
print(f"Offline GPU: {crack(guesses / 1e10)}")
print(f"Score: {score}/100")
print("Notes: " + (", ".join(notes) if notes else "no obvious weak pattern"))
